user.title: Connect to SATEL INTEGRA through a legacy ETHM-1
user.description: Enable TCP/IP Integration on ETHM-1. Leave the integration key empty for clear-text communication, or enter the same key configured in DLOADX when Integration encryption is enabled.

reconfigure.title: Configure SATEL ETHM-1 Legacy
reconfigure.description: The encryption key must match the Integration encryption setting in ETHM-1. This version keeps the 0.1.x sensor/discovery logic unchanged.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to ETHM-1 or read the panel. Check the address, port and encryption setting/key.
error.invalid_code: The user code must contain only 1-16 digits.
error.invalid_key: The integration key must contain at most 12 ASCII characters.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.invalid_zones: Enter zone numbers as a list/range, e.g. 1-8,10,12.
